ValidationRule.description: Quote status management. If denied ==> cannot be changed if accepted ==> cannot change to Presented pr Draft
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($User.ER_BypassVR__c), OR( AND( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE( Status ) , "Accepted"), OR( ISPICKVAL( Status , "Presented"), ISPICKVAL( Status , "Draft"), ISPICKVAL( Status , "Approved") ) ), AND( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE( Status ) , "Denied"), ISCHANGED(Status) ) ) )
